defs.d: An opinion offered in an effort to be helpful.
defs.ex: She was offered various piece of advice on what to do with her new-found wealth.

defs.d: Deliberate consideration; knowledge.
The part of the day from noon or lunchtime until sunset, evening, or suppertime or 6pm.
The later part of anything, often with implications of decline.
(more often in the plural) In the afternoon.
Clipping of good afternoon.
An instrument used to measure or keep track of time; a non-portable timepiece.
The odometer of a motor vehicle.
defs.ex: This car has over 300,000 miles on the clock.

defs.d: To measure the duration of.
To measure the speed of.
defs.ex: He was clocked at 155 miles per hour.

defs.d: A complete domicile occupying only part of a building, especially one for rent; a flat.
A suite of rooms within a domicile, designated for a specific person or persons and including a bedroom.
A person who prepares food.

defs.d: The head cook of a manor house
A set amount of travelling, seen as a single unit; a discrete trip, a voyage.
Any process or progression likened to a journey, especially one that involves difficulties or personal development.

defs.d: To travel, to make a trip or voyage.
A stringed musical instrument, of European origin, usually with a fretted fingerboard and six strings, played with the fingers or a plectrum (guitar pick).

Any type of musical instrument of the lute family, characterized by a flat back, along with a neck whose upper surface is in the same plane as the soundboard, with strings along the neck and parallel to the soundboard.
To play the guitar.
Work that is done at home, especially school exercises assigned by a teacher.

defs.d: Preliminary or preparatory work, such as research.
defs.ex: The speaker had certainly done his homework before delivering the lecture.

defs.d: To want something to happen, with a sense of expectation that it might.
defs.ex: I am still hoping that all will turn out well.

defs.d: To be optimistic; be full of hope; have hopes.
To communicate, usually by means of speech.

defs.d: To discuss; to talk about.

defs.d: A plant of the family Piperaceae.
A spice prepared from the fermented, dried, unripe berries of this plant.
To add pepper to.
To strike with something made up of small particles.
(heading) Of time.

To roam, walk, wander.
To set some distance apart.
A male or female attendant who serves customers at their tables in a restaurant, café or similar.

Any period of seven consecutive days.
A period of seven days beginning with Sunday or Monday.
To hold inside.
To include as a part.
The control center of the central nervous system of an animal located in the skull which is responsible for perception, cognition, attention, memory, emotion, and action.
An intelligent person.

defs.d: To dash out the brains of; to kill by smashing the skull.
To strike (someone) on the head.

A stage of proficiency or qualification in a course of study, now especially an award bestowed by a university or, in some countries, a college, as a certification of academic achievement. (In the United States, can include secondary schools.)
defs.ex: She has two bachelor's degrees and is studying towards a master's degree.

defs.d: A unit of measurement of angle equal to 1/360 of a circle's circumference.

defs.d: The worth of something; value.
The proportional relationship between one amount, value etc. and another.

defs.d: To assign or be assigned a particular rank or level.
defs.ex: She is rated fourth in the country.

defs.d: To evaluate or estimate the value of.
defs.ex: They rate his talents highly.

defs.d: The act of shaking or being shaken; tremulous or back-and-forth motion.

defs.d: A milkshake.
To cause (something) to move rapidly in opposite directions alternatingly.
defs.ex: He shook the can of soda for thirty seconds before delivering it to me, so that, when I popped it open, soda went everywhere.

defs.d: To move (one's head) from side to side, especially to indicate refusal, reluctance or disapproval.
defs.ex: Shaking his head, he kept repeating "No, no, no".

defs.d: The act of adding anything.

defs.d: Anything that is added.
A spherically contained volume of air or other gas, especially one made from soapy liquid.
A small spherical cavity in a solid material.

defs.d: To produce bubbles, to rise up in bubbles (such as in foods cooking or liquids boiling).
To churn or foment, as if wishing to rise to the surface.

To accept something willingly or gladly.

defs.d: Producing gladness.
defs.ex: a welcome present;  welcome news

The inhabitants of a region, especially the native inhabitants.
Of or pertaining to the inhabitants of a land, their culture, tradition, or history.
Of or pertaining to common people as opposed to ruling classes or elites.
The act of touching physically; being in close association.
The establishment of communication (with).

defs.d: To touch; to come into physical contact with.

defs.d: To establish communication with something or someone
defs.ex: I am trying to contact my sister.

defs.d: Pertaining to culture.
The fact of creating something, or bringing something into being; production, creation.
The act of creating a living creature or organism; procreation.
To observe certain events; undergo a certain feeling or process; or perform certain actions that may alter one or contribute to one's knowledge, opinions, or skills.
Having experience and skill in a subject.
Experient.
The systematic recitation of an event or series of events.
That which is narrated.
Telling a story.
Overly talkative; garrulous.
(in some African communities) To publicly display a child after it has been named
Situated in, designed to be used in, or carried on in the open air.
Pertaining to charity administered or received away from, or independently from, a workhouse or other institution.
To proofread.
To make resistant, especially to water.
The process of dough proofing.
To demonstrate that something is true or viable; to give proof for.

defs.d: To turn out; to manifest.

defs.d: An abstract and general idea; an abstraction.

Understanding retained in the mind, from experience, reasoning and imagination; a generalization (generic, basic form), or abstraction (mental impression), of a particular set of instances or occurrences (specific, though different, recorded manifestations of the concept).
A personal possession such as jewellery, of relatively great monetary value; — usually used in plural form.
Having a great value.

defs.d: Estimable; deserving esteem.
defs.ex: a valuable friend; a valuable companion

defs.d: Anything that goes beyond what is ordinary.
Not ordinary; exceptional; unusual.
Remarkably good.
defs.ex: an extraordinary poet

defs.d: A trust or confidence in the intentions or abilities of a person, object, or ideal from prior empirical evidence.
defs.ex: I have faith in the goodness of my fellow man.

defs.d: The process of forming or understanding abstractions, ideas, or beliefs, without empirical evidence, experience or observation.
defs.ex: I have faith in the healing power of crystals.

defs.d: Someone who has control over something or someone.
The owner of an animal or slave.
To be a master.
To become the master of; to subject to one's will, control, or authority; to conquer; to overpower; to subdue.
Masterful.
defs.ex: a master performance

defs.d: Main, principal or predominant.
The act of observing, and the fact of being observed (see observance)
The act of noting and recording some event; or the record of such noting.
Strong of its kind or in character; unmitigated; virulent; thorough; utter (used of negative things).

defs.d: Strong in growth; growing with vigour or rapidity, hence, coarse or gross.

defs.d: Quickly, eagerly, impetuously.
Type or kind. (Compare race.)

defs.d: An image, an appearance, a spectacle.
A crack or longitudinal fissure.
A breach or separation, as in a political party; a division.

Divided.

defs.d: (of a short exact sequence) Having the middle group equal to the direct product of the others.
A sweet spread made of any of a variety of fruits.
A reservation, a nature preserve.
To protect; to keep from harm or injury.

defs.d: To save from decay by the use of some preservative substance, such as sugar or salt; to season and prepare (fruits, meat, etc.) for storage.
defs.ex: to preserve peaches or grapes
